test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 6 July 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Umesh earns a simple interest of Rs. 1,600 on a certain sum in two years at the rate of 4% per annum. How much more interest would he have earned if he had invested the same sum at 4% interest per annum, compounded annually?
solution:
**Given:**

Umesh earns a simple interest of Rs. 1,600 on a certain sum in two years at the rate of 4% per annum.

**Concept used:**

For a certain principal if the simple interest is S at the rate of R% for 2 years, then in the same principal at the same rate and time difference between compound interest and simple interest will be {(S × R)/200}

**Calculation:**

Here S = 1600 R = 4

So, The difference between compound interest and simple interest is (1600 × 4)/200

⇒ 32

**∴ The required answer is Rs. 32.**
